Please give it some attention
Travel Notice for Companion Animal Passengers

Travelers must review their animal travel arrangements before arrival at Aurelia Skyways.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk handles each journey as a shared responsibility, with the senior coordinator guiding daily service decisions and the cabin team watching over animals during flight. Please prepare the crate, documents, and comfort items in advance so the check-in record can be completed without delay. <<FACT F068>> Keep the animal calm, secure, and ready for staff review.

Care plans are arranged according to species, temperament, and comfort needs, and travelers should follow all instructions given by the desk. If a pet shows signs of stress, notify staff at once so the record can be updated and support can be arranged. This notice is meant to reduce confusion and help travelers move through the process in an orderly way.

For final guidance, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure.
